title: Hotpoint Special

problems: Row 10 "everyone take one step forward, turn to face right, and single-file one place clockwise" can't start from where the dancers are: A slide along the set needs free hands.
Row 11 "slide left along set single-file, larks leading" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
The progression after row 11 "slide left along set single-file, larks leading" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
Row 12 "right left through with next neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
